# Psalm 82 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm of-Asaph. God stands in-assembly-of God; in-midst-of gods he-judges.

**2** 'How-long will-you-judge unjustly, and-face-of the-wicked will-you-lift-up? Selah.

**3** Judge the-weak and-the-fatherless; the-afflicted and-the-destitute vindicate.

**4** Rescue the-weak and-the-needy; from-hand-of the-wicked deliver.

**5** Not they-know and-not they-understand, in-darkness they-walk-about; are-shaken all foundations-of the-earth.

**6** I said, "Gods you-are, and-sons-of the-Most-High all-of-you.

**7** But like-man you-will-die, and-like-one-of the-princes you-will-fall."

**8** Arise O-God, judge the-earth, for you will-inherit among-all the-nations.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **82:1**: Elohim nitsav ba'adat-El — 'God stands in assembly-of God'; the 'gods' (elohim) may be divine beings, judges, or rulers to whom God delegated authority.

- **82:6-7**: 'Gods you-are' (elohim attem) — cited by Jesus in John 10:34. The 'gods' will die like mortals for their unjust rule.

— EMET
